```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "challenges/**"
      - "scripts/**"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "challenges/**"
      - "scripts/**"

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  python-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8

      - name: Run black
        run: black --check .

      - name: Run isort
        run: isort --check-only .

      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 .

  cpp-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang-format
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-format

      - name: Run clang-format
        run: |
          find . -name "*.cu" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.hpp" | head -20 | xargs clang-format -style=file -Werror --dry-run

  mojo-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate Mojo files
        run: |
          find . -name "*.mojo" -exec sh -c 'echo "Validating {}"; grep -q "from mojo import.*" "{}" || echo "Warning: Missing import statement in {}"' \;
```
